race.comment: WEHAVTIME NZ (1) has been solid from tougher barriers in the last two outings here, coming from wide on the back row for a 1.6m third last time. Led from one spot wider to score at Redcliffe three back so has the speed to take full advantage of the ace draw. SHEZ A PUNTER (8) draws to trail the top pick and enjoy a nice run. Could be dangerous with the sprint lane in play. RACANA NZ (7) has been tackling some good mares of late so with luck from a wide barrier can do better here. BETTOR CHEER NZ (6) came from the back row and finished third last start after scoring at the previous appearance. First four player.
